scope: Secondary descriptor-exchange diagnostic; average task pairs and seeds within each image, then weight images equally. Distinct from task/class-balanced main classification.

49.scope: Descriptor exchange on the same image using fixed trained selectors and cached score vectors.
49.aggregation: Average repeated seeds and task-pair rows within image, then weight images equally. Bootstrap resamples images.
49.panel_scope: Exchange-eligible anchor-image panel; these accuracies are not balanced binary-task benchmark accuracies.
49.task_split_scope: Unseen combinations are primary and seen combinations secondary; their task collections differ, so their contrast alone is not a pure transfer effect.
49.quartile_boundary_rule: An exact boundary belongs to the higher-numbered stratum.
